import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

run = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5]
backend = root / "backend"
exe = backend / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe"
source_baseline_path = root / "work/ceres-v3/05/candidate-v6/baseline.json"
review_scope_path = root / "work/ceres-v3/05/review-v6/review-scope.json"
zip_path = root / "work/ceres-v3/05/candidate-v6/source.zip"
source_baseline = json.loads(source_baseline_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
review_scope = json.loads(review_scope_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def sha256(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()

def path_hashes(mapping):
    result = {}
    missing = []
    mismatched = []
    for rel, expected in mapping.items():
        p = root / rel
        if not p.is_file():
            missing.append(rel)
            continue
        actual = sha256(p)
        result[rel] = actual
        if actual != expected:
            mismatched.append({"path": rel, "expected": expected, "actual": actual})
    return {"count": len(mapping), "actual_count": len(result), "sha256": result,
            "missing": missing, "mismatched": mismatched,
            "matches": not missing and not mismatched and len(result) == len(mapping)}

before = path_hashes(source_baseline["sha256"])
review_before = path_hashes(review_scope["sha256"])
zip_hash = sha256(zip_path)
freeze_gate = {
    "candidate_version": source_baseline.get("candidate_version"),
    "source_path_count": source_baseline.get("source_path_count"),
    "source_count_matches": source_baseline.get("source_path_count") == 306 and before["matches"],
    "candidate_zip_actual": zip_hash,
    "candidate_zip_expected": "31983d299e75eb6128a6f617f1cfa5830f0a0e85e82b58a28b852bb192bd204a",
    "candidate_zip_matches": zip_hash == "31983d299e75eb6128a6f617f1cfa5830f0a0e85e82b58a28b852bb192bd204a",
    "review_scope_count": len(review_scope["paths"]),
    "review_scope_hashes_match": review_before["matches"],
    "review_scope_fixed_head": review_scope.get("baseline_head"),
    "review_scope_commit_list": review_scope.get("commit_list"),
}
(run / "freeze-gate.json").write_text(json.dumps({"gate": freeze_gate, "source_before": before,
    "review_scope_before": review_before}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
if not all([freeze_gate["source_count_matches"], freeze_gate["candidate_zip_matches"],
            freeze_gate["review_scope_hashes_match"], freeze_gate["review_scope_count"] == 14]):
    raise SystemExit("freeze gate failed; probe not started")

plugin_dir = run / "plugin"
evidence_dir = run / "live-evidence"
temp_dir = run / "temp"
basetemp = run / "pytest-basetemp"
for p in (evidence_dir, temp_dir, basetemp):
    p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
ledger = run / "probe-ledger.json"
args = [str(exe), "-X", "utf8", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "--showlocals",
        "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-W", "error::pytest.PytestUnhandledThreadExceptionWarning",
        "--basetemp", str(basetemp), "-p", "malformed_selection_probe",
        "-k", "R01 and not variant", "tests/test_v3_live_sampling.py"]
child_env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in ("PATH", "SystemRoot", "WINDIR") if k in os.environ}
controlled_env = {
    "PYTHONUTF8": "1", "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "PYTHONUNBUFFERED": "1",
    "PYTHONPATH": str(plugin_dir), "PYTHONNOUSERSITE": "1",
    "TEMP": str(temp_dir), "TMP": str(temp_dir), "TMPDIR": str(temp_dir),
    "USERPROFILE": str(temp_dir), "HOME": str(temp_dir),
    "CERES_V3_LIVE_EVIDENCE_DIR": str(evidence_dir),
    "CERES_V3_PROBE_LEDGER": str(ledger),
    "LLM_MODE": "live", "BUSINESS_DATA_MODE": "demo",
    "OPENAI_BASE_URL": "http://model-blocked.invalid/v1", "OPENAI_API_KEY": "codex-controlled-probe",
    "LLM_MODEL": "observer-probe-only", "MEMORY_MODEL": "",
    "KEV_BASE_URL": "http://kev-blocked.invalid",
    "LLM_TIMEOUT": "1", "LLM_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS": "256",
    "RETRIEVAL_MODE": "lexical", "RETRIEVAL_INDEX_DIR": "",
    "SOURCE_DATABASE_PATH": str(root / "data/sale_guide.db"),
    "DATABASE_URL": "sqlite:///" + str(temp_dir / "runtime.sqlite3").replace("\\", "/"),
    "EMBEDDING_BASE_URL": "", "EMBEDDING_API_KEY": "", "EMBEDDING_MODEL": "",
    "INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN": "", "HTTP_PROXY": "", "HTTPS_PROXY": "", "ALL_PROXY": "",
    "http_proxy": "", "https_proxy": "", "all_proxy": "", "NO_PROXY": "*", "no_proxy": "*",
}
child_env.update(controlled_env)
stdout_path = run / "stdout.txt"
stderr_path = run / "stderr.txt"
started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
with stdout_path.open("wb") as stdout, stderr_path.open("wb") as stderr:
    proc = subprocess.Popen(args, cwd=backend, env=child_env, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
    pid = proc.pid
    receipt_running = {"started_at": started, "pid": pid, "argv": args,
        "cwd": str(backend), "environment_set": controlled_env,
        "environment_policy": "minimal inherited PATH/SystemRoot/WINDIR plus listed controlled variables; no ambient credentials copied",
        "python_version": sys.version, "pytest_version": importlib.metadata.version("pytest"),
        "httpx_version": importlib.metadata.version("httpx"),
        "httpx2_version": importlib.metadata.version("httpx2"),
        "starlette_version": importlib.metadata.version("starlette"),
        "source_before_matches_306": before["matches"], "review_scope_before_matches_14": review_before["matches"],
        "candidate_zip_sha256": zip_hash}
    (run / "process-start.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt_running, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    exit_code = proc.wait()
ended = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
after = path_hashes(source_baseline["sha256"])
review_after = path_hashes(review_scope["sha256"])
receipt = {**receipt_running, "ended_at": ended, "exit_code": exit_code,
           "source_after_matches_306": after["matches"],
           "source_stable_306": before["sha256"] == after["sha256"] and before["matches"] and after["matches"],
           "review_scope_after_matches_14": review_after["matches"],
           "review_scope_stable_14": review_before["sha256"] == review_after["sha256"] and review_before["matches"] and review_after["matches"],
           "stdout_path": str(stdout_path), "stderr_path": str(stderr_path),
           "probe_ledger_path": str(ledger), "live_evidence_dir": str(evidence_dir),
           "freeze_gate": freeze_gate}
(run / "run-receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
(run / "source-after.json").write_text(json.dumps({"source": after, "review_scope": review_after}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"run_dir": str(run), "pid": pid, "exit_code": exit_code,
                  "stdout": str(stdout_path), "stderr": str(stderr_path),
                  "source_stable_306": receipt["source_stable_306"],
                  "review_scope_stable_14": receipt["review_scope_stable_14"]}, ensure_ascii=False))
